name: Axelar
description: Axelar delivers secure cross-chain communication for Web3. Our infrastructure enables dApp users to interact with any asset or application, on any chain, with one click.

genuineSpikes: 105M of USDf, mMEV and mEDGE deposited on Ethereum by one address

methodology.Fees: Total gas fees paid by users (excluding gas refunds)

Fees.Transaction Gas Fees: Gas fees paid by users for cross-chain contract calls, express calls, and with-token calls through Axelar bridge
Fees.Gas Refunds: Refunds issued to users when transactions fail or gas is overpaid (shown as negative to reduce total fees)
